content:
LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead, and the short version is this: warm, dry, and a little breezy — classic late-October Laredo.

Monday stays partly cloudy with a high near 83. Tuesday warms to 86 under partly cloudy skies. Wednesday through Saturday are the hottest stretch of the week, with highs of 89 each day and plenty of sunshine mixed with a few clouds.

Sunday turns cloudier with a high near 87. Overnight lows stay in the 60s all week — pleasant sleeping weather with the windows open.

Rain chances are slim: 0 to 10 percent through Saturday, ticking up to 20 percent Sunday night. Winds stay light to moderate out of the east and southeast, picking up a bit Friday and Saturday. No weather alerts are in effect for Webb County.

Bottom line: no jackets needed, sunscreen still a good idea, and Halloween-week plans look safe. Stay cool out there, Webb County.

Sources:

  • National Weather Service — Brownsville (Laredo & Webb County forecast)
